name: Outlier Detect
description: Flags rows whose numeric values fall outside a per-column outlier range with an added Boolean 'outlier' column: IQR fences (q1 - k*iqr, q3 + k*iqr) or z-score bounds (mean +- k*stddev). A row is flagged when any listed column is outside its range, missing values are never outliers, and the statistics come from the whole input table.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns checked for outliers; a row is flagged when any of them is outside its range.

method.title: Method
method.description: iqr uses quartile fences, zscore uses the distance from the mean in standard deviations.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Multiplier for the fence width: the IQR multiplier (default 1.5) or the z-score limit (default 3).
